mapping.name: Tcp Connections
mapping.description: Each row is a TCP or UDP endpoint from a Sysinternals Tcpvcon snapshot, with owning process and identifier, protocol and state, and local or remote addresses and ports. Use it to correlate collection-time network exposure with processes and other telemetry. It contains no payload or connection history, and process attribution can become stale as identifiers are reused.
mapping.short_description: Shows captured Windows TCP and UDP endpoints with owning processes, connection state, and local or remote addresses.

field.description: Protocol. e.g. TCP, UDP, TCPV6, UDPV6
LISTENING, ESTABLISHED, … (can be empty for UDP)
